# NanoDet-Plus-1.5x

Object Detection · `nanodet-plus-1.5x_224x224` · DX-APP Python example

Object Detection model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 416 × 416 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** Apache-2.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![NanoDet-Plus-1.5x output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models NanoDetPlusM_15
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/nanodet/nanodet-plus-1.5x_224x224/nanodet-plus-1.5x_224x224_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/nanodet-plus-1.5x_224x224.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target nanodet-plus-1.5x_224x224_sync   # once
./bin/nanodet-plus-1.5x_224x224_sync \
  -m assets/models/nanodet-plus-1.5x_224x224.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 27.15 |
| Q-Lite | 26.52 (−0.63) |
| Q-Pro | 26.67 (−0.48) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.
